verdict: A near-exact rebuild of the screen: every block sits within a few pixels, but it is set in Inter instead of SF Pro and the tab bar is an opaque white, so the feed does not show through it; the file is well named, mostly auto-layout, with components for the repeated rows, but no shared styles.

top_defects.where: whole screen (Today, card text, section titles, tab labels)
top_defects.what: Inter used throughout instead of SF Pro: different glyph shapes (a, y, t) and widths, and the text sits about 1 pt higher in every line box; the heatmap outlines every text run

the reference's translucent capsule shows the blurred row 2 description ('Article de liste de Wikimédia') and the rank circle through it; the candidate's bar is near-opaque white, so that content is lost
the reference clips 'présidentielle' at the card's edge with no ellipsis; the candidate truncates it with '…'
the square.on.square glyph has more rounded corners and a heavier stroke than the reference's sharper squares
the Pablo Pagis photo is cropped wider (the player looks smaller than in the reference's tighter crop); the Star Academy logo is scaled and cropped differently behind the tab bar

top_defects.where: status bar, segmented control, tab bar
top_defects.what: offsets of 1–3 px: the clock and battery are shifted, the segment track and the tab-bar capsule edges are slightly off (heatmap rings around the capsules)
no text or color styles (styled: 0), so #202122, #72777d and #3366cc are repeated as raw values; the four tab items are copied frames rather than instances
magic fractional gaps (62.599998 px, 11.3 px, 15.5 px) and many anonymous 'Vector' layers (including ten 1×1 calendar dots)

strengths: Every block (card hidden banner, Games card, Top read list, floating top bar and tab bar) matches the reference's position and size within a few pixels, with exact text, accents and colors (#3366cc links, #72777d subtitles)
Real vectors for every icon, including the status bar, the Wikipedia W and the filled SF-style tab icons, with the right glyph in each slot
Section Header, Game Question Row and Top Read Row are components with instances, inside a clearly named auto-layout tree
